title: mimosa dolens var. rigescens
intro: Mimosa dolens var. rigescens, commonly known as the sensitive plant, is a flowering plant species in the legume family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Mimosa dolens var. rigescens include sedation and muscle relaxation, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
